DOG LICENSING FEES

Dog licenses are required under section 7.04.020 of the Pomeroy Municipal Code.

 

RESOLUTION 24-10

 

2025 DOG LICENSE FEES

 

Dog License Fees for the year 2025 shall be set as follows:

​

Annual License, Spayed or Neutered Dog     $  15.00

Annual License, Intact Dog                              $  25.00

Lifetime License, Spayed or Neutered Dog   $  35.00

Annual License, Dangerous Dog                     $500.00

Replacement Tag                                              $    5.00

 

Approved this 5th day of November, 2024:

 

Signed:                                                           

 

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\__           

Jack Peasley, Mayor

  

Attest:

  

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\__

Diane L. Taylor, City Clerk/Treasurer

​

ANIMALS MUST BE KEPT ON A LEASH WHEN AWAY FROM THEIR PLACE OF RESIDENCE.

​

DOGS MUST BE SPAYED OR NEUTERED FOR A LIFETIME LICENSE.

DOG LICENSES ARE NOT TRANSFERABLE.
